'''Jilrua''' was a [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] a [[Blue giant/Legends|blue giant]] [[Star/Legends|star]]<ref name="TEA" /> within the [[Jilrua system/Legends|Jilrua system]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] region,<ref name="EAOC" /> in the immediate vicinity of the [[Oktos Nebula/Legends|Oktos Nebula]].<ref name="TEA" />

Jilrua was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Jilruan/Legends|Jilruans]], a war-like [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that was conquered by members of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] species<ref name="TEA" /> and that contributed [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] to the Hutt [[Army/Legends|armies]] by the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[25,100 BBY]].<ref name="EGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> The planet was rarely visited by outsiders.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jilrua was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the planet in grid square R-12.<ref name="TEA" />
